heading: Meet Annette Taddeo
text: In 2017, Annette Taddeo made history as the first Latina Democrat elected to the Florida State Senate — winning a special election that flipped a Trump district from red to blue.

heading: Meet Annette Taddeo
text: Now she’s running for Chief Financial Officer — because Florida’s families are being robbed in plain sight. Insurance companies are raking in profits while homeowners can’t afford to stay in their homes. Tallahassee insiders are protecting themselves and their donors instead of the people who elected them.

heading: A CFO Who Works for You
text: Florida families deserve a CFO who works for you — not the insurance companies, not the insiders, not the status quo. Annette Taddeo will be our watchdog in Tallahassee!

heading: Lowering Insurance Costs
text: Right now, Florida’s families are getting crushed by property insurance rates and high costs. But instead of doing anything about it, politicians in Tallahassee are turning a blind eye. As CFO, Annette Taddeo will do what should have been happening all along: hold the Big Insurance companies accountable and lower costs for working families.

heading: Unrigging the System
text: Floridians have watched corruption run rampant in Tallahassee for too long: no-bid contracts going to big donors. Millions spent on political stunts with no oversight. Scandals involving our tax dollars swept under the rug. As CFO, Annette Taddeo will put Floridians, not special interests, first. She’ll audit politicians’ spending and demand answers on behalf of taxpayers.

heading: Protecting Consumers
text: The Office of the CFO is made up of several specialized offices, including Worker’s Compensation, Fire Safety, Insurance Claim Assistance, Financial Literacy, Fraud Tracking and Reporting, and more. Annette Taddeo will make sure that the Office of the CFO is putting Floridians first, protecting consumers, and is responsive, helpful, and timely when it comes to all requests.

heading: Transparency and Accountability
text: Floridians deserve to know how and where our tax dollars are being spent. They deserve to know who we award contracts to for public projects. They deserve transparency from the Office of the CFO, and Annette Taddeo will make sure that happens. She’ll bring her three decades of experience running her own business and a proven track record of public service to the fight for transparency and accountability.
